course.title: Deep Learning for Computer Vision
course.instructor: Fei-Fei Li, Ehsan Adeli, with Zane Durante and guest lecturers

figureAudit.note: Counts are for the decks of the covered lectures (lecture 1 has two, lecture 2 one). Lecture 1: eight figure-, chart- and table-heavy slides per deck checked at 600 dpi by an independent reader; part 2 clean, part 1 errors on slides 62 and 64, corrected. Lecture 2: fourteen slides checked; errors on slides 8, 33 and 64 and loose detail on 30, 45 and 63, corrected; eight clean.

images.discovery: inline in wiki/ and raw/slides/; each slide file's header lists its rendered slides; no index file
images.note: Lectures 1 and 2 only. Lecture 1: 47 of part 1's 69 pages and 17 of part 2's 50. Lecture 2: 41 of 102 pages. Not rendered: title, agenda, administrative and divider slides, text-only and code slides, build steps whose final step is rendered, tables and formulas the slide file reproduces exactly, and photographs of course staff and award winners.

caveats: Covers lectures 1 and 2 of 18 only; nothing on lectures 3-18.

Lecture 1 has two slide decks, each numbered from 1; cite as 'part 1, slide N' / 'part 2, slide N'. Part 2's printed numbers skip 4, 5 and 45, and lecture 2's skip 32 and 49, so printed numbers run ahead of PDF page numbers.
Lecture 1's logistics slides (part 2, slides 33-48 and 50) were not presented in the recording; wiki/course-logistics.md is sourced to the slides as posted on April 1, 2025.

Lecture 2's recording skips its administrative slides (2-4) and ends mid-sentence at 1:06:37, before the multiclass SVM loss (a reading assignment, slides 85-100) and softmax vs. SVM (slides 101-104); those are sourced to the slides alone, and their quiz questions have no printed answers.
Lecture 2's deck prints two arithmetic slips in worked examples (slide 60's ship score omits the bias; slide 101's 0.452 is a base-10 log); both are kept as printed and noted.
Verbatim auto-captions are not published; the transcripts are copy-edits with every restoration listed in their headers, seven passages marked unclear in lecture 1 and five in lecture 2.
